verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Semgrep integrates into CI at push/PR/MR events, posts PR/MR comments for Secrets findings, and offers a GitHub integration for automating PR review comments, with findings sent to the AppSec Platform after scans. missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of GitHub/GitLab PR status checks (not just comments) for Semgrep Code/Supply Chain findings, and independent hands-on confirmation of the PR-comment UX beyond docs.
